data.narrative: Adapted the planning artifacts through two successive scope changes: B2B company accounts with timeline compression, and role-based access control with department visibility. Pivot to a proper database model was executed while keeping the 6-day investor demo on track by cutting non-essential UI features.

dimension_scores.observation: Pivoted from Minimal Bridge (Option B) to proper database modeling (Option A) once roles and departments made the bridge unviable.

strengths: Demonstrated excellent engineering judgment by choosing the right moment to abandon the Minimal Bridge hack and pivot to proper database modeling once roles and departments were introduced.
Exhibited a clear production and PM-facing mindset, writing a highly specific, trade-off oriented impact statement that maintains trust.
data.recommendation: In Module 8, practice the end-to-end integration and verification of these adapted database models and visibility constraints.
